deviations.what: When the base is empty, the anti-join against base keeps every forward class, so new_classes equals |F| instead of NA.
The line replaces every NA new_classes with 0, so an empty base yields 0 instead of NA, and new_classes is never NA, breaking the rule that it is NA exactly when n_base_classes is 0.

notes: Everything else matches the spec: filing_year dating, first-listed and missing-class handling, the base window fy+1..fy+5 and forward window fy-1..fy-3 (so year t is in neither), the no-forward rule giving 0, firm-keyed joins, deduplication, and the output columns. Focal years come from the firm_year input, which the spec allows, and the empty-string check at line 12 is a reasonable reading of missing.
